skill_drafts.name: Stream Event Processing for Agent Output
skill_drafts.description: Iterate over agent event streams, filter by event type, and output text-generation events in real-time. Use when consuming streaming responses from agent frameworks that emit structured event objects.
skill_drafts.objective: Process and display streamed text-generation events from agent execution
applicable_signals: stream object available from agent execution
contraindications: Batch processing is preferred over streaming
Event stream is not available or is None
Output buffering or aggregation is required before display
workflow_steps: Receive or obtain the event stream from agent framework
Iterate over stream using for-loop or equivalent
Extract event.text when condition is true
Output text without line termination (end='' or equivalent)
triggers: Agent framework returns streaming event objects
Event objects have event_type and text attributes
constraints: Each event must have event_type and text attributes
Output must not block stream consumption
cautions: Ensure stream is properly closed or exhausted to avoid resource leaks
Handle empty or malformed event.text gracefully
output_contract: Text content from text-generation events is printed or collected in real-time without blocking stream consumption. Non-text-generation events are silently skipped.

examples.input: stream object from agent framework with events: [Event(event_type='text-generation', text='Hello'), Event(event_type='metadata', text='...'), Event(event_type='text-generation', text=' World')]
examples.output: Hello World (printed to stdout without newlines between segments)
examples.notes: Non-text-generation events are filtered out; text segments are concatenated in real-time

metadata.prompt: Iterate over the event stream. For each event, check if event.event_type equals 'text-generation'. If true, extract and output event.text without adding newlines (use end='' or equivalent). Continue until stream is exhausted.

skill_drafts.name: Agent Session Lifecycle Termination
skill_drafts.description: End an agent session with a status label and finalize tracking and logging. Invoke after agent execution completes to cleanly close the session and record final status in the agent tracking system.
skill_drafts.objective: Cleanly terminate an agent session and record final status
workflow_steps: Confirm session is active and not yet terminated
Call agentops.end_session() with appropriate status string
Await confirmation that session is closed
triggers: Agent task execution is complete; session tracking is active; final status must be recorded
constraints: Session must be initialized before termination
Status parameter must be a valid string (e.g., 'Success', 'Failure')
Only one termination call per session
output_contract: Session closed with status recorded in agent tracking system; no further logging or tracking occurs for this session

examples.output: agentops.end_session('Success') → session closed and marked as successful in tracking system
examples.notes: Standard success case after normal agent completion

metadata.prompt: Call agentops.end_session() with a status string (e.g., 'Success') after all agent task execution is complete. This operation finalizes session tracking, closes logging, and records the terminal state.
